title: A Small Light Becomes a Story

shots.action: The guide opens a glowing sketchbook while the student leans closer.

dialogue.speaker: guide
dialogue.text: Describe the story as data; the director reveals the scene.

shots.action: The student smiles as simple shapes become an expressive 2D world.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: So the simple recipe can still unfold into advanced animation.
